issues: Attempt 01 selected tokenizer auxiliaries as well as generation responses and reused an extraction filename. Its saved reference integrity check detects seven stale extraction hashes. Original provider artifacts were unchanged.

correction.method: The executed tools/diagnose_performance.py command freezes its source, correlates native lane sequence bounds, selects only final chat/completions requests, uses unique output names and verifies every extracted body and source reference hash.
